trajectory_summary: This is a low-friction, cooperative call that moved efficiently from verify to booking despite some rep fumbling (mixed-up pronoun errors, disorganized pacing) and a messy mid-call ownership/billing tangent. The rep held scope discipline on pricing questions and pivoted the bill-collection hurdle (daughter's name on the account) reasonably quickly rather than stalling, but left a strong bill-pain and neighbor-social-proof signal completely unused as leverage. Outcome is a real booked appointment with day and time locked, though thin on the button-up mechanics.

observed_outcome.quote: So we got you for 2PM, on March 18.
observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (March 18) and time (2PM) were confirmed by the rep and accepted by the customer without objection, meeting the bar for a booked outcome. No clear co-owner was confirmed for the appointment given the ambiguity of the title/deed exchange at 01:15.
